key_insight: CODA combines patient-cohort patterns with individual deviations to support multimodal clinical reasoning.
clinical_relevance: This approach aims to make EHR-based AI reasoning sensitive to both shared patient characteristics and patient-specific differences.
method: Uses reinforcement learning to discover clinically meaningful patient cohorts.
Represents each patient's deviation from a cohort prototype as a structured drift signal.
Integrates cohort and drift representations into a multimodal foundation model.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports consistent effectiveness and strong generalizability on real-world EHR benchmarks for closed-QA, open-QA, and report generation, without numerical results.
watch_item: Benchmark performance does not establish clinical safety or prospective utility; cohort robustness across patient populations needs validation.
paper_title: CODA: Cohort- and Drift-aware Foundation Model for Multimodal Clinical Reasoning
